summary: Completed testing of U-6 Sector Rotation and U-7 Channel Lifecycle features. Backend APIs fully functional with proper rotation data and lifecycle classification. Frontend rotation page working with period selector, summary cards, table, and navigation. Minor UI issue with period selector value attribute.

ui_bugs.issue: Select value attribute shows 'None' instead of selected value, but functionality works correctly

✅ Rotation page loads with correct table structure
✅ Status badges (ROTATING IN/OUT/STABLE) with correct styling
✅ Delta cells with proper color coding (green/red/gray)
✅ Navigation flow: Telegram -> Sectors -> Rotation working

action_item_for_main_agent: Consider adding a frontend page/component to display channel lifecycle classifications (EMERGING, EXPANDING, MATURE, SATURATED, DECLINING, STABLE) as the API is working but there's no UI to consume it in the telegram section.
